topic: Choose the best data persistence strategy for a high-traffic read-heavy API.

priorDecision.reasoning: Lower operational complexity and strong consistency outweigh marginal throughput gains of caching.

rejectedAlternatives.rejectionReason: Cache stampede risk and invalidation complexity at scale.
critiques: Invalidation logic adds significant maintenance burden.

unresolvedRisks.description: Replication lag under write spikes not fully benchmarked.

covered.summary: Both proposals evaluated under simulated load. Read replicas scored higher on ops simplicity.

notCovered.reason: Current workload is read-heavy (95:5 read/write ratio); write scaling not in scope.

reuseConstraint.applicabilityNote: Prior debate covered the same API persistence question. Workload ratio unchanged. New debate should re-examine replication lag risk identified as unresolved.
